text: My Wi-Fi dropped halfway through a 4 GB upload. Voltius waited for the link to come back and carried on from where it stopped. A cut-off copy never replaces the real file, and a resumed one is checked end to end. New in 0.49.0.
Moving off Termius takes one click. Voltius reads your hosts, folders, keys and snippets straight from the installed app. No export file. No account.
No account required. Install, add a host, connect. Signing up is optional, and it stays optional.
Force-quit Voltius in the middle of a build. Reopen it. Tabs, splits, scrollback and the running build are still there.
Type once. Run on twelve servers.
What does your SSH client do that drives you nuts? I read every reply, and a lot of Voltius started as one.
Drag a folder from one server to another. It streams across as tar over SSH, straight through Voltius: nothing saved on your laptop, no temp archive on either host.
Let Claude Code drive your fleet. Voltius ships an MCP server: hosts, sessions, commands, files. Off by default, never leaves your machine.
Still on PuTTY? Voltius imports your saved sessions with their proxies and tunnels, then gives you tabs, split panes and SFTP on top. Add your keys to the keychain once and every host can use them.
Local-first means Voltius works on a plane. Sync is a bonus, never a dependency.

text: Six built-in themes, one click each. Or make your own in the theme editor.
Close the laptop. Open your phone. Same live terminal, mid-command.
Sync your hosts end-to-end encrypted through your own private GitHub Gist. No central server. Bring your own token.
Proxmox LXC and Docker containers in the same sidebar as your SSH hosts. Open a shell in one click.
300 servers in a spreadsheet? Import the CSV. Names, ports, users and tags come from its columns, not from an afternoon of copy-paste.
Every host, one keystroke.
Copying a huge folder used to fail on hosts with a tiny /tmp. Now Voltius streams tar over SSH, no temporary archive.
"Which prod host has a runaway process? Open a tab on it." One prompt, real tabs.
MobaXterm sessions → Voltius in one click. Same hosts, now with E2EE sync across Linux, macOS, Windows and Android.
This is all Voltius Cloud ever sees of your SSH fleet. Hosts and keys are encrypted on your device, synced in real time, and decrypted on your other devices. Pro, 14 days free, no card.

text: Share a live terminal with a teammate. Hand over control, take it back. A guest without control can't type.

Recently in Voltius: icons and colors for your folders, whole folders sent over SSH as one compressed stream, chmod on local files right from the SFTP pane, and ZOC hosts imported without hunting for the config file.
Double-click a file on the server, edit it right in Voltius, Ctrl+S, and it's saved on the server. No scp round trip.
Serial console with DTR, RTS and break. For the router you bricked at 2 a.m.
SecureCRT import is in. Point Voltius at your config and your session tree comes across, folders included.
On tmux 3.2+, persistent sessions feel like plain SSH: native scroll, drag-select, Ctrl+F through history, mouse apps.
Prefer Cloudflare? Voltius deploys a Worker and an R2 bucket you own, from Settings. Same zero-knowledge sync.
Works with Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code. One toggle in Settings → Integrations.
Sessions survive disconnects through tmux or screen on the host. You don't need to know tmux for this to work.
ZOC Terminal import finds your hosts in the installed app, even if you moved its data folder somewhere custom.
Save a command once as a snippet, run it on any host from the side panel. Variables ask before they run.
chmod and chown from the right-click menu, on remote panes and now on local ones too.
Or any S3-compatible bucket: AWS, R2, B2, Wasabi, Hetzner, Scaleway, MinIO. Encrypted before it leaves your machine. No server to deploy.
Live CPU, memory and disk for the host you're on, next to the terminal.
Share hosts in a team vault, and connect as your own identity. Your choice stays yours, the shared credential stays shared.
I wrote importers for Termius, MobaXterm, PuTTY/KiTTY, SecureCRT, ZOC and CSV so nobody has to retype a hostname again. Which client should be next?
Port forwards that survive sleep. Close the lid, open it, the tunnel is back. https://voltius.app/blog/port-forwards-that-survive-sleep
Ask your agent which hosts you haven't connected to in 30 days. It reads your Voltius audit log, locally.
Local shells too: Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, WSL, Git Bash, CMD. One app for every terminal you open.
Voltius is AGPL-3.0. You can read every line of the code that holds your SSH keys.
What's the oldest box you still SSH into?
WebDAV hosts in the file browser: Nextcloud, ownCloud, Synology, TrueNAS, rclone. Browse, upload, edit.
No lock-in, both ways. Everything exports to open JSON, encrypted if you want. Leaving Voltius should be as easy as arriving.
See and kill processes on any connected host, without typing ps aux | grep.
Voltius runs on Android. Your hosts, keys and live sessions in your pocket, synced end-to-end encrypted.
Voltius opens a shell on OpenWrt and other busybox boxes, even the ones without base64.
Yes, I added FTP in 2026. Here's why. https://voltius.app/blog/why-we-added-ftp-in-2026
Running a team? The sync server is one container image you can host yourself.
Plugins from the official registry, or point Voltius at your own repo.
Permissions per folder and per host for teams that need them, end-to-end encrypted like everything else.
Everything in the free list stays free. Paid plans add Voltius Cloud and teams; they never take features away.
